fail  User namespaces     AppArmor restricts unprivileged user namespaces, so bubblewrap cannot isolate commands
                          fix:  sudo tee /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap > /dev/null <<'EOF'
                                abi <abi/4.0>,
                                include <tunables/global>

                                profile bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap flags=(unconfined) {
                                  userns,
                                  include if exists <local/bwrap>
                                }
                                EOF
